features.title: VisualCore public API compatibility and renderer capability probing
features.deliverable: query actual EGL/GL ES entry points; extensions; drawbuffer formats; MSAA; shader versions; instrumentation

features.title: Numerical foundations and deterministic seeded scene time
features.deliverable: fixed step clock; seed hashing; stable math; IEEE hygiene; replay logs; transform conventions

features.title: GPU resource ownership and pipeline lifetime
features.deliverable: per-context residency; resource caches; immutable descriptors; main loop ownership; destruction ordering

features.title: Procedural mesh compiler and mesh validation
features.deliverable: indexed vertices; surfaces; bevels; tubes; manifold validation; normals; bounds

features.title: Shader domain-specific parameters and GL ES safe compilation
features.deliverable: shader preprocessing; embedded program variants; precision qualifiers; compile diagnostics; stable uniforms

features.title: Linear-color/HDR-look emissive pass and mobile-safe bloom
features.deliverable: linear scene values; half resolution blur; tone mapping; pre-multiplied alpha; flash reduction

features.title: Curve, ribbon, and tube batch renderer
features.deliverable: adaptive curves; parallel transport; continuous texture coordinates; tangent frame and collapse
features.consumers: Aurora Loom; Lissajous Labyrinth; Wave Knot Keeper; Chrono Constellator; Backwards Aurora; Harmonic Bridges; Acoustic Constellator; Starlit Cartouche; Apsides Workshop

features.title: Instancing and point/beam renderer

features.consumers: Hue Compass; Echo Cartographer; Acoustic Constellator; Microscopic Aurora; Starlight Surveyors

features.title: Spectral color & non-color clue accessibility
features.deliverable: hue transforms; perceptual luminance; shape encoding; colorblind presets; noncolor status
features.consumers: Aurora Loom; Hue Compass; Colorfall Canyons; Backwards Aurora

features.title: SDF and constructive geometry proxy library
features.deliverable: analytic plane/sphere/box distance; signed volume sampling; conservative raymarch option
features.consumers: Amethyst Escape; Faceted Forge; Echo Cartographer; Crystal Quarry

features.title: Convex solid clipping & polygon robustness
features.deliverable: half-space mesh intersection; stable epsilon; face winding; volume ledger; degenerate removal

features.title: Shadow stencil and geometric silhouette analysis
features.deliverable: projection of 3D polygons; rasterized mask; intersection-over-union; no GPU readback for logic
features.consumers: Nocturne Garden; Moonlit Mechanism; Celestial Eclipse Lab

features.title: Deterministic timeline and reversible history
features.deliverable: event log; snapshot ring; rewind; timeline editing; replay hashes; save migration
features.consumers: Chrono Constellator; Backwards Aurora; Starlit Cartouche

features.title: Conic orbit and eclipse geometry
features.deliverable: Kepler anomaly solver; projected overlap; phase stepping; visibility classification
features.consumers: Celestial Eclipse Lab; Apsides Workshop; Binary Gardens; Starlit Cartouche

features.title: Grid, graph, and route-solver toolkit
features.deliverable: BFS/A*; time-expanded graphs; cut sets; graph isomorphism subsets; solver certificates
features.consumers: Colorfall Canyons; Echo Cartographer; Acoustic Constellator; Mycelium Architect; Crystal Quarry

features.title: Fluid-heightfield transport and conservation
features.deliverable: conservative flows; explicit bounded steps; dye mass; erosion; stable clamps

features.title: Procedural terrain mesh and skydome
features.deliverable: heightfield LOD; deterministic erosion masks; raster-free procedural sky
features.consumers: Colorfall Canyons; Erosion Painter; Crystal Quarry

features.title: Organic grammar & compact vegetation generator
features.deliverable: L-systems; parametric petals, caps, stems; deterministic instancing
features.consumers: Nocturne Garden; Mushroom Weather; Binary Gardens; Mycelium Architect

features.title: Bounded swarm and steering simulation
features.deliverable: deterministic boids; neighborhood grid; magnetic fields; density raster

features.title: Diffusion, nutrient, and viability field solver
features.deliverable: explicit stable diffusion; local sources/sinks; bounded graph growth; conservation reports
features.consumers: Mushroom Weather; Binary Gardens; Mycelium Architect

features.title: Spatial controls and analytic picking

features.title: Puzzle contract, seed generation and solver certification

features.title: Procedural content authoring, balancing and catalogs
